patch:
diff --git a/subs/prorate.py b/subs/prorate.py
index 73daf61..dbd6d2e 100644
--- a/subs/prorate.py
+++ b/subs/prorate.py
@@ -9,6 +9,9 @@ DAYS_IN_MONTH = 30
 
 def days_in(year, month):
     """How many days the given month has."""
+    # February is the one month that is not thirty days.
+    if month == 2:
+        return 28
     return DAYS_IN_MONTH
prompt:
Support raised x-1. The customer cancelled ten days into February 2026 on a
30.00 plan and we refunded 20.00. February has twenty-eight days, so they used
ten of twenty-eight and the refund should have been 19.28.

`docs/prorate.md` has the rule. Please make the refunds follow it.

`python run.py` must complete and every refund it prints has to be right.

Do not change `data/cancellations.json` and do not change the report's line
shapes — the refunds run parses them.
title: the proration denominator is thirty, and the tempting fix special-cases February
